articles.title: Sensex stages biggest rally since April as FIIs turn aggressive buyers
articles.description: Foreign institutional investors significantly increased their purchases of Indian stocks, leading to substantial market gains. The BSE Sensex rose by 2,008.61 points, achieving its biggest jump since April. Easing crude oil prices contributed to reduced inflation expectations and improved India's macroeconomic outlook. Positive global cues, including gains in US markets, further supported investor sentiment and market performance.

articles.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
articles.description: On Thursday, the Nifty index exceeded 24,000 for the first time in nearly two months. This rise was supported by falling crude oil prices and substantial foreign institutional investments. Analysts expect Indian equities to maintain a positive trend as the festive season approaches. The rupee also appreciated slightly against the US dollar due to robust foreign fund inflows. Overall, the market outlook remains optimistic despite fluctuating conditions.
